statement.zh: **协议**：SRTP 安全实时传输（Secure Real-time Transport Protocol）。RFC 3711 摘要给出定位与能力清单：「This document describes the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP), a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」即它是 RTP 的密码学剖面，同时管媒体与控制流量。
statement.en: **Protocol**: Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP 安全实时传输).The abstract supplies both placement and capability list: "This document describes the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP), a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP)." It is a cryptographic profile of RTP, covering media and control traffic.

statement.zh: 摘要说明它给 RTP 与 RTCP 控制流量补上安全服务：「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」注意措辞是 can provide——能力取决于所选密码套件与密钥管理，不是默认全开。
statement.en: The abstract states the services it adds to RTP and its control protocol: "a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP)." The wording is can provide — the services depend on the selected cipher suite and on key management rather than being unconditional.

statement.zh: 使用面是音视频与实时会话的承载加密：文档以「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP)」界定其作用位置，并在框架一节定义密码上下文与包处理流程；语音、视频会议等实现按该剖面套用在既有 RTP 报文之上。
statement.en: In practice it secures audio, video and interactive sessions: the document places itself as "a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP)" and its framework section defines cryptographic contexts and packet processing, applied on top of existing RTP payloads by voice and video-conferencing implementations.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 限度一是它不规定密钥管理协议：§1 明确安全性有条件——「With appropriate key management (Sections 7 and 8), SRTP is secure (Sections 9) for unicast and multicast RTP applications (Section 11).」§8 名为 Key Management Considerations，对所使用的密钥管理提出约束，却不定义协商协议。限度二是保护范围只到 RTP/RTCP 流量，与应用层协议无关。
statement.en: The first limit: no key-management protocol is specified.§1 makes security conditional — "With appropriate key management (Sections 7 and 8), SRTP is secure (Sections 9) for unicast and multicast RTP applications (Section 11)." — and §8, Key Management Considerations, constrains whatever key management is used without defining an agreement protocol.

版本信息在页眉与版权块：Request for Comments 3711，Network Working Group，日期 March 2004，版权行为「Copyright (C) The Internet Society (2004).All Rights Reserved.」（IETF Trust 的版权样式属于此后的文件）。本文件的自我定位是 RTP 的一个 profile，而非新的传输协议。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SRTP 安全实时传输的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: The masthead and copyright block carry the history: Request for Comments 3711 from the Network Working Group, dated March 2004, under "Copyright (C) The Internet Society (2004).All Rights Reserved." — the IETF Trust copyright wording belongs to later documents.
